text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Rulership...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Rulership is pointing,
I see a crane game filled with plushies
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's placed in a rather tricky spot...
However... it's not out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The prize's position, its weight, the crane's strength, and its maneuverability. As long as I calculate all of those correctly—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I can take control of this board.
Let's test my skills!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Hahaha! A piece of cake!
Nothing to it when I'm on the job!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, sorry to keep you waiting.
You're up next.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You're not the type to just sit back and watch
when there's an interesting game right in front of you, are you?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
